description: Manages downtimes in Icinga 2 through its REST API.

parameters.name: all_services
parameters.description: Whether downtimes should be created for all services of the matched host objects. If omitted, Icinga 2 does not create downtimes for all services of the matched host objects by default. Choices: false true

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Name of the author. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: CA certificates bundle to use to verify the Icinga 2 server certificate.

parameters.name: child_options
parameters.description: Schedule child downtimes. Choices: "DowntimeNoChildren" "DowntimeTriggeredChildren" "DowntimeNonTriggeredChildren"

parameters.name: client_cert
parameters.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for SSL client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, client_key is not required.

parameters.name: client_key
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for SSL client authentication. If client_cert contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

parameters.name: comment
parameters.description: A descriptive comment. Default: "Downtime scheduled by Ansible"

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration of the downtime. Required in case of a flexible downtime.

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: End time of the downtime as UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter expression limiting the objects to operate on.

parameters.name: filter_vars
parameters.description: Variable names and values used in the filter expression.

parameters.name: fixed
parameters.description: Whether the downtime is fixed or flexible. If omitted, Icinga 2 creates a fixed downtime by default. Choices: false true

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: If yes do not get a cached copy. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: force_basic_auth
parameters.description: Credentials specified with url_username and url_password should be passed in HTTP Header. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs. Default: "ansible-httpget"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the downtime object. This option has no effect for states other than absent.

parameters.name: object_type
parameters.description: Use Host for a host downtime and Service for a service downtime. Use Downtime and give the name of the downtime object you want to remove. Choices: "Service" "Host" ← (default) "Downtime"

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: Start time of the downtime as UNIX timestamp.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the downtime. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to wait for the server to send data before giving up. Default: 10

parameters.name: trigger_name
parameters.description: Name of the downtime trigger.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: URL of the Icinga 2 REST API.

parameters.name: url_password
parameters.description: The password for use in HTTP basic authentication. If the url_username parameter is not specified, the url_password parameter will not be used.

parameters.name: url_username
parameters.description: The username for use in HTTP basic authentication. This parameter can be used without url_password for sites that allow empty passwords.

parameters.name: use_gssapi
parameters.description: Use GSSAPI to perform the authentication, typically this is for Kerberos or Kerberos through Negotiate authentication. Requires the Python library gssapi to be installed. Credentials for GSSAPI can be specified with url_username/url_password or with the GSSAPI env var KRB5CCNAME that specified a custom Kerberos credential cache. NTLM authentication is not supported even if the GSSAPI mech for NTLM has been installed. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: use_proxy
parameters.description: If no, it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If no, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Schedule a host downtime
  community.general.icinga2_downtime:
    url: "https://icinga2.example.com:5665"
    url_username: icingadmin
    url_password: secret
    state: present
    author: Ansible
    comment: Scheduled downtime for test purposes.
    all_services: true
    start_time: "{{ downtime_start_time }}"
    end_time: "{{ downtime_end_time }}"
    duration: "{{ downtime_duration }}"
    fixed: true
    object_type: Host
    filter: host.name=="host.example.com"
  delegate_to: localhost
  register: icinga2_downtime_response
  vars:
    downtime_start_time: "{{ ansible_date_time['epoch'] | int }}"
    downtime_end_time: "{{ downtime_start_time | int + 3600 }}"
    downtime_duration: "{{ downtime_end_time | int - downtime_start_time | int }}"

- name: Remove scheduled host downtime
  community.general.icinga2_downtime:
    url: "https://icinga2.example.com:5665"
    url_username: icingadmin
    url_password: secret
    state: absent
    author: Ansible
    object_type: Downtime
    name: "{{ icinga2_downtime_response.results[0].name }}"
  delegate_to: localhost
  when: icinga2_downtime_response.results | default([]) | length > 0

return_values.name: error
return_values.description: Error message as JSON dictionary returned from the Icinga 2 API. Returned: if downtime scheduling or removal did not succeed Sample: {"error": 404, "status": "No objects found."}

return_values.name: results
return_values.description: Results of downtime scheduling or removal Returned: success Sample: [{"code": 200, "legacy_id": 28911, "name": "host.example.com!e19c705a-54c2-49c5-8014-70ff624f9e51", "status": "Successfully scheduled downtime 'host.example.com!e19c705a-54c2-49c5-8014-70ff624f9e51' for object 'host.example.com'."}]

return_values.name: code
return_values.description: Success or error code of downtime scheduling. Returned: always Sample: 200

return_values.name: legacy_id
return_values.description: Legacy id of the downtime object. Returned: if a downtime was scheduled successfully Sample: 28911

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the downtime object. Returned: if a downtime was scheduled successfully Sample: "host.example.com!e19c705a-54c2-49c5-8014-70ff624f9e51"

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Human-readable message describing the result of downtime scheduling. Returned: always Sample: "Successfully scheduled downtime 'host.example.com!e19c705a-54c2-49c5-8014-70ff624f9e51' for object 'host.example.com'."
